plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that around 1976, during the SALT talks, arms-limitation negotiations between the United States and the Soviet Union, the US diplomat Henry Kissinger told the Soviet official Anatoly Dobrynin to stop beaming the American embassy in Moscow with microwaves. Michels connects this to the US ambassador of the time, Walter Stoessel, and credits reporting by the German magazine Der Spiegel and the American TV news show 60 Minutes. He tells it because it would show that governments were already aiming energy at people in secret decades ago.
